description: A labelled set for measuring the triage classifier (DESIGN.md §4, §10).
Deliberately weighted toward hard cases. Easy ones inflate accuracy and
tell you nothing; what matters is the error *direction* on the messages a
human would hesitate over. The `hard` flag marks cases where a reasonable
person could label it differently — those are reported separately so a
good score on the clear cases cannot hide a bad one on the rest.
Labels are my judgement, which is itself a limitation: this measures
agreement with me, not ground truth.
